caption: Doe I v. Chaparro
citation_line: Doe I v. Chaparro, No. 3:25-cv-13961, ECF No. 16 (D.N.J. Dec. 22, 2025)
headnote_district_ruling: Allowed two adults alleging childhood sexual assault to proceed under pseudonyms. Applying Megless, the court credited sworn evidence of PTSD-related harm and found that the public interest in open proceedings did not require disclosure of nonpublic victims' identities.
qualification_rationale: A careful, accessible application of Third Circuit pseudonymity doctrine to highly sensitive allegations and the public's countervailing interests.
appellate_posture_note: Non-dispositive anonymity order; no substantive appellate review identified.
subject_screen_exclusion_reason: Pseudonymity order governing party identification rather than substantive liability or relief.
